children: Chardan Capital maintained their Buy rating on Ocular Therapeutix's stock with a price target of $23.00.
The price target implies an upside of 125.7% from the Sep 15 close of $10.19.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Ocular Therapeutix recently had a favorable Pre-NDA meeting with the FDA for its product AXPAXLI, confirming that the expectations for the NDA submission are consistent with previous communications. This de-risked regulatory path enhances confidence in their upcoming filing, which is expected to occur in 4Q26.

: AXPAXLI is the only novel asset in the wet age-related macular degeneration (AMD) space that has demonstrated a positive prespecified Phase 3 superiority result against an approved anti-VEGF treatment, which positions Ocular Therapeutix favorably amidst a narrowing competitive landscape.
